cohort: 328 children from the Copenhagen Prospective Studies on Asthma in the Childhood2000 (COPSAC2000) at-risk birth cohort
finding: Season of birth was associated with nasopharyngeal bacterial richness at 1 month of age, with higher bacterial richness in summer-born children.
mod_finding: This study found no association between mode of delivery and nasopharyngeal bacterial richness in 1-month old infants.
